_README: Copy to the app's userData folder as firebase.config.json, or point PCMS_FIREBASE_CONFIG at this file in dev. These are the PUBLIC Firebase web-app values (Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app, the firebaseConfig object) — they are NOT secrets. googleClientId / googleClientSecret are the OAuth 2.0 'Desktop app' credentials used for the system-browser Google sign-in; for a desktop client the secret is non-confidential but is kept PC-only (this file is gitignored, never uploaded). Do NOT put GA4 / SendGrid / AI API keys here; those live in the Functions environment.
